sentences.gloss: The child is eating an apple.
My mother is cooking a soup.
My mother is cooking the soup.
You are buying a loaf of bread.
I would like a tea, please.
The child drinks a lot of milk.
We are buying sugar and salt.

sentences.text: Wir haben Brot, Käse und Eier.
sentences.gloss: We have bread, cheese and eggs.

sentences.text: Die Frau kauft Wein und Bier.
sentences.gloss: The woman is buying wine and beer.
alts: Die Frau kauft Bier und Wein.

sentences.text: Wir trinken Tee und essen Brot.
sentences.gloss: We drink tea and eat bread.

sentences.text: Ich trinke weder Tee noch Kaffee.
sentences.gloss: I drink neither tea nor coffee.
alts: Ich trinke weder Kaffee noch Tee.

sentences.text: Er isst weder Fleisch noch Fisch.
sentences.gloss: He eats neither meat nor fish.
alts: Er isst weder Fisch noch Fleisch.

sentences.text: Wir haben weder Zucker noch Milch.
sentences.gloss: We have neither sugar nor milk.
alts: Wir haben weder Milch noch Zucker.

sentences.text: Nein, danke. Ich will keinen Tee.
sentences.gloss: No, thank you. I don’t want any tea.
Do you want tea or coffee?
Do you drink wine or beer?
Do you eat fish or meat?
Would you like rice or bread? (polite)
Do you like fruit? – Yes, of course!
Do you really not eat meat?
Don’t you eat meat? – Yes, I do!

sentences.text: Magst du keinen Käse? Doch, ich mag Käse.
sentences.gloss: Don’t you like cheese? – Oh yes, I do like cheese.

sentences.text: Trinkst du keinen Kaffee? Nein, ich trinke nur Tee.
sentences.gloss: Don’t you drink coffee? – No, I only drink tea.
Would you like a juice too?
